details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:40451-40455 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_review_gate_rate_limit_requeue_decide`, `$gate_reruns` counts only gate markers where `.gate.head == $e.oid`. Re-dispatched review runs are workflow_dispatch runs started by `_dispatch_review_for_conflicts`, which pass only `pr_number`. In those runs `PR_HEAD_SHA` is empty (.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:691), so `_gate_write_rate_limit_marker` writes `head=unknown`, and the counter never counts those markers.
  WHY: If the requeue marker POST fails (likely under GH_PAT pressure), `$retries` and `$gate_reruns` both stay 0, so attempts never reach `RATE_LIMIT_REQUEUE_MAX_ATTEMPTS`. The PR is then re-dispatched after every reset without limit, which breaks the issue's bounded-retry requirement. test_review_requeue_counts_gate_reruns_without_requeue_markers misses this because every marker it builds uses HEAD_A. Severity was MAJOR from all reviewers who stated one; gemini stated none.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:261-282 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `rl_replay_source` jq block in `_replay_rate_limited_clarify` does not treat the poller's own earlier `/reclarify [auto-requeued-by-poller]` + `<!-- ai:clarify-rate-limit-replay:v1 run=X source=0 -->` comment as an automated source. As a result, chained replays after a second rate limit are posted as `source=<id>` instead of `source=0`.
  WHY: clarify.yml:982-986 restarts only `source=0` as an automated release. A `source=<id>` replay logs `reason=human_source outcome=human_reclarify` and leaves `IS_FORCED_RECLARIFY=true` (clarify.yml:815-817), so attempts 2 and 3 skip the `orchestrator_fast_path` defer at clarify.yml:1026 and run with human-answer semantics. No test covers a chained replay. Severity was MAJOR from all reviewers who stated one; gemini stated none.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:40451-40455 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `$retries` and `$gate_reruns` in `_review_gate_rate_limit_requeue_decide` are counted over all of `$c[]` with no lower bound or reset point. The clarify path, by contrast, anchors its count to the newest PAT success outcome `$ok`.
  WHY: Gate markers from separate rate-limit incidents on the same head, with successful reviews in between, build up. A later single rc=75 can then escalate straight to `ai:needs-human` with no automatic re-entry. Severity was NIT from sonnet, minimax and z-ai; gemini filed it under PERFORMANCE with no severity.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:982-991 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The rate-limit replay classification block (#10031) sets `COMMENT_ROUTE_TRUSTED="true"` only in the verified `source=0` branch. A verified `source=<id>` replay (from a human `/reclarify`) falls into the `else` branch and leaves the trust flag at its default.
  WHY: The route gate at clarify.yml:832-836 drops the replay comment with `reason=untrusted_comment_author`. Because the poller has already removed `ai:reclarify-requeue`, the rate-limited human `/reclarify` is never re-entered. Severity was MAJOR from minimax; gemini stated none. Disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly rejected this premise. They say the replay is posted with GH_PAT, and clarify.yml:832-836 trusts it via author_association OWNER/MEMBER.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The retry is bounded (a small fixed number of re-entries per item) and then escalates with `ai:needs-human` and a comment that names the cause." (PR review-gate path)
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh `_review_gate_rate_limit_requeue_decide` (`$retries` / `$gate_reruns`); tests/test_rate_limit_requeue.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The cap holds only while every requeue marker POST succeeds (`$retries`) or rerun gate markers carry the current head SHA (`$gate_reruns`). The fallback `$gate_reruns` never matches the `head=unknown` markers that dispatched reruns write (review_autofix.yml:691 is empty on workflow_dispatch), and no test drives rerun markers with head=unknown.
- requirement: "Entry point: the existing scheduled poller (`AI Orchestrate Poller`) for issues and the scheduled `AI Review` sweep for PRs." / "A review gate that exits on `AUTOFIX_GATE_PR_READ_FAILED rc=75` is picked up again by the next scheduled review sweep instead of being treated as handled."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml, scheduled PR candidate/re-dispatch path
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The PR diff does not change `review_autofix_sweep.yml` (it is not in `pr_changed_files.txt`). `run_review_gate_rate_limit_requeue_pass` is wired only into `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:40572` (the orchestrator poller). PRs outside orchestrator-tracked projects never appear in `_STANDALONE_ISSUELESS_RETRY_STATE`. tests/test_rate_limit_requeue.py exercises the poller pass, not a review-sweep selection path. Reviewer severities were BLOCKER (gemini), MAJOR (minimax) and NIT (luna). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly rejected this gap: `review_autofix_sweep.yml` is not in the plan's files_touched grant, and the issue delegates naming the files to the implementer.
- requirement: "A clarify run that exits on `rc=75` (rate limited) leaves a durable, machine-readable marker on the issue, and a scheduled job re-enters clarify once the reset time has passed."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/clarify.yml `clarify_route` rate-limit replay classification block, verified + source=<id> branch
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: No hunk sets `COMMENT_ROUTE_TRUSTED="true"` for the verified + source=<id> replay branch. Because the poller removes the label, the human-triggered rate-limited item is never re-entered.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_review_gate_rate_limit_requeue_decide `$gate_reruns` jq line (related: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:691; scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh _gate_write_rate_limit_marker; scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:31513-31516 `_dispatch_review_for_conflicts`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `$gate_reruns` counts only markers whose head equals `$e.oid`. Dispatched re-runs write `head=unknown`, so the count stays 0.
  WHY: If the requeue-marker POST fails, the decision is `eligible` with attempts=0 after every reset, the PR is re-dispatched forever and never reaches `escalate`/`ai:needs-human`. test_review_requeue_counts_gate_reruns_without_requeue_markers passes only because `_gate_body` defaults to `head=HEAD_A`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_replay_rate_limited_clarify `rl_replay_source` jq block (related: .github/workflows/clarify.yml:982-990) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The poller's earlier `/reclarify [auto-requeued-by-poller]` + `<!-- ai:clarify-rate-limit-replay:v1 run=X source=0 -->` comment is not treated as automated, so the chained replay gets `rl_replay_source=R1`.
  WHY: Replays 2 and 3 are posted as `source=<R1 id>`, which logs `reason=human_source`. IS_FORCED_RECLARIFY stays true from line 817, the `orchestrator_fast_path` defer at line 1026 is skipped, and no test covers this.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_review_gate_rate_limit_requeue_decide `$retries`/`$gate_reruns` over all of `$c[]` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The PR attempt count has no reset point, unlike the clarify path's `$ok`.
  WHY: Same-head markers from unrelated earlier rc=75 runs build up, so a later single rc=75 escalates straight to `ai:needs-human`.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "The retry is bounded (a small fixed number of re-entries per item) and then escalates with `ai:needs-human` and a comment that names the cause." (PR review-gate path)
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh _review_gate_rate_limit_requeue_decide (attempt counting); tests/test_rate_limit_requeue.py needs a re-run gate marker with head=unknown
  Evidence of absence: The cap holds only while every requeue marker POST succeeds. `$gate_reruns` never matches `head=unknown` markers (review_autofix.yml:691 is empty on workflow_dispatch), and no test covers this.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- NOTES (2 related items): rejected z-ai's untrusted_comment_author claim (the replay is posted with GH_PAT, clarify.yml:832-836 trusts OWNER/MEMBER, the same mechanism as line 898); rejected the AI Review sweep TASK_GAP (review_autofix_sweep.yml is not in files_touched).
- HARDENING (2 related items): `$gate_reruns` should also count `.gate.head == "unknown"` (1 line); the `rl_replay_source` jq should add a chained source=0 replay `or` clause (2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
